h1: Prajaktra Design Hotel — a boutique design stay by Nong Prajak Lake, Udon Thani
intro: Picture this: you draw the curtains in the morning and Nong Prajak Lake with its fountain sits right in front of you, and a few steps across the road takes you to the city park where Udon locals jog and cycle every dawn — Prajaktra Design Hotel is a modern boutique hotel sitting on what many guests call the best location in town · 79 rooms with an outdoor pool, a rooftop and a free airport shuttle · from approx. ฿1,100/night · scored 8.7 from real guest reviews.

body.html: Prajaktra Design Hotel is a mid-size design hotel of 79 rooms that has been open since around 2010 · What sets it apart from other downtown Udon hotels is its location directly across from Nong Prajak Public Park — the central city park with a lake, fountains and walking-and-cycling paths around the water · Many reviews name this location as the main reason they booked, since you can wake up and walk or cycle around the lake straight away, while still being close enough to ride to Central or UD Town in a few minutes.

Rooms are decorated in a modern style with warm tones, ranging from a roughly 30 sqm Superior to the 64 sqm Grand Design Suite · A point guests mention often is that the rooms are larger than expected and clean, with comfortable beds · Some rooms face Nong Prajak Lake and the fountain, and reviews consistently suggest asking for a balcony room facing the lake, since the view is lovely both by day and in the evening when the fountain is lit · To be straight about it, because the hotel has been open for a while, some rooms and bathrooms show wear and are due for a refresh, so if you want a room in good shape, ask for a renovated one at check-in.
"Opened the curtains in the morning to a full view of Nong Prajak and just walked across the road to cycle the lake before breakfast — a location you won't find at other Udon hotels."

The hotel has an outdoor pool that many reviews call bigger and nicer than expected for a hotel this size · There is a rooftop area for evening dinner and drinks with a good night atmosphere, but with the caveat that the rooftop venue is not open every day, so ask the front desk first if you plan to head up for an evening meal · Breakfast is a buffet with both Thai and Western options, and most guests say it is solid and more generous than they expected at this price · There is also a fitness room, free parking and bicycles to borrow.

Another thing reviews praise consistently is the friendly service and the free airport shuttle · Staff are helpful, check-in is hassle-free, and the free round-trip Udon Thani airport shuttle saves both money and time since the airport is only minutes away · Many travellers who fly into Udon to continue on to Nong Khai, Vientiane or to tour the city say this is a real advantage that brings them back.

To give the full picture, there is some inconsistency in upkeep at times · A few reviews describe air-conditioning that needs a manual reset, a bathroom drain that empties slowly, or housekeeping that did not fully clean or restock on certain days · Some guests found the pool not yet cleaned on the day they arrived · These do not happen to everyone, but they show that maintenance standards still depend on the day — if you hit a problem, tell the front desk right away, as most issues are fixed quickly.

The overall score is 8.7 from around 60 reviews on Trip.com, with similar scores on Booking.com and Agoda · These numbers show most guests are happy, especially with the location, large rooms, pool and service, while the complaints tend to centre on the age of some rooms and uneven housekeeping — both manageable by choosing your room well and flagging issues early.

Bottom line from real guest reviews: Prajaktra Design Hotel suits travellers who want to stay by Nong Prajak Lake, get a spacious design room with a pool and a free airport shuttle, at a wallet-friendly price · If you like waking up to walk or cycle around the park, want a lake view, and don't mind that the hotel isn't brand-new in every corner, it offers good value · But if you expect a fully renovated hotel with flawless daily upkeep, you'll want to pick your room carefully or look at newer options in town.

honestSummary: Prajaktra Design Hotel is the best pick for travellers who want to stay by Nong Prajak Lake, get a spacious design room with a pool and a free airport shuttle, at a wallet-friendly price · But you have to accept that the hotel has been open a while — some rooms feel dated and upkeep is uneven, so choose your room and flag any issue early.
honestChecks: If you expect a brand-new hotel in every corner — some rooms and bathrooms show wear and are due for a refresh → ask for a renovated room at check-in, or look at newer options in town.
If you want a lake-and-fountain view — not every room faces Nong Prajak → specify a lake-view room with a balcony when you book.
If you plan to have dinner on the rooftop — the venue isn't open every day → call or ask the front desk to confirm opening hours before you plan around it.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Prajaktra Design Hotel Udon Thani

faq.q: Where is Prajaktra Design Hotel and what's nearby?
faq.a: Prajaktra Design Hotel sits on Suppakitchanya Road in Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani, directly across from Nong Prajak Public Park · You can walk across the road to the park and lake · It's about 7 minutes' drive from Central Plaza, 8 minutes from UD Town and around 10 minutes from Udon Thani Airport.

faq.q: How much does Prajaktra Design Hotel cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at approx. ฿1,100/night for a Superior Room of around 30 sqm · Larger options include the Deluxe Room (~40 sqm), Design Suite (~48 sqm) and Grand Design Suite (~64 sqm) · Many rooms have Nong Prajak Lake views · High-season rates rise, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Prajaktra Design Hotel have a pool and a rooftop?
faq.a: Yes · an outdoor pool that many reviews call bigger than expected for a hotel this size, plus a rooftop area for evening dinner and drinks with city views · Note the rooftop venue isn't open every day, so check with the front desk first if you plan to head up for an evening meal.

faq.q: Does Prajaktra Design Hotel have an airport shuttle?
faq.a: Yes · the hotel offers a free round-trip Udon Thani airport shuttle, a point reviews praise often, especially for travellers flying into Udon to continue on to Nong Khai or Vientiane · Give the front desk your flight details in advance to arrange a pickup time.

faq.q: Who is Prajaktra Design Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for travellers who want to stay by Nong Prajak Lake, like walking or cycling around the park, and want a spacious design room with a pool at a wallet-friendly price · It suits couples, families and travellers connecting onward to Nong Khai or Vientiane alike.

faq.q: What are the downsides to know before booking Prajaktra Design Hotel?
faq.a: Because the hotel has been open a while, some rooms and bathrooms feel dated and are due for a refresh · A few reviews mention A/C that needs a manual reset, slow drainage, or housekeeping that didn't fully clean on certain days · These don't happen to everyone, but if you hit one, tell the front desk right away as most issues are fixed quickly.
